steps: Multiply resource inequalities by the nonnegative prices1,1 with units currency/h.
Sum them; capacities give10currency; coefficient sum equals revenue vector.

At(2,2), both capacities are attained and quantities are nonnegative; revenue is10.
Every feasible point has revenue<=10 by eq:lp-bound. Thus(2,2)is globally optimal.
